newsitem.title: USA: Flamemaster sets 3 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Flamemaster sets 3 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Flamemaster Corp said Tuesday its board of directors has approved a 3 percent stock dividend in anticipation of further revenue and earnings growth.
The stock dividend will be paid on April 17 to shareholders of record on April 1. Fractional shares will be paid in cash at the rate of $6.00 per share.

The company said in a statement sales for the month of January rose 25 percent to to $253,278 from $202,514 in January 1996. New orders for January 1997 gained 48 percent to $324,100 from $218,950 in the previous year.
